properties.description: Lewis acid-base pre-reaction complex H2C=O->BH3 (single dot-free bound complex; B-O 1.61 A, C=O 1.22 A, C...H(B) 2.62 A). B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, gas phase, 18 real frequencies, 0 imaginary. Lowest verified conformer of the adduct; the planar Cs arrangement is a BH3-libration saddle (-211.6 cm-1) and was discarded.

Four-centre B-H-C-O hydride-transfer saddle. The declared SMILES is the reacting-system connectivity (the same Lewis-adduct connectivity as RC, since the saddle is a point on that PES and no single bond-order assignment describes it); the node's identity is fixed by its native evidence. C=O 1.234, B-O 1.772, B-H8 1.238, C...H8 2.136 A; exactly one imaginary frequency -398.9 cm-1 (next real mode 186.0 cm-1) dominated by the hydride moving from B3 to C1; OptTS log ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0006/ts_opt/refine.log; bidirectional IRC ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0006/irc/irc.log connects RC and P.
Methoxyborane H2B-O-CH3 (C-O 1.416 A, O-B 1.341 A), B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP gas phase, 18 real frequencies, 0 imaginary.
